title: Reimagining the app experience
summary: Driving app engagement through interactive prototyping for Boost Mobile.

meta.tools: Figma, Claude Code, Google Stitch, UserZoom

sections.label: OVERVIEW
sections.title: Driving app engagement and completion rates through interactive prototyping.
sections.body: As the lead designer and researcher, I benchmarked core usability metrics, developed a coded prototype featuring new reward systems, and successfully pitched the validated UX to Account Executives to drive future revenue goals.

sections.label: PROBLEM
sections.title: Addressing broken feedback loops in a static, utilitarian app.
sections.body: User research revealed a consistent gap: people struggled to understand where they were in a flow, what action to take next, and whether their submissions were successful. These breakdowns in clarity and feedback led to low completion rates and stalled sessions across essential tasks.

sections.label: SOLUTION
sections.title: Prototyping in code for high-fidelity validation.
sections.body: To accurately test the impact of animations and interactive rewards, static screens weren't enough. I designed the core features in Figma and utilized **Figma MCP** and **Claude Code** to rapidly build a functional, interactive prototype. This allowed me to test real micro-interactions through unmoderated usability testing in UserZoom.

mediaBlocks.caption: Boost as a feeling.
mediaBlocks.body: The bubble animation introduces a sense of anticipation.

mediaBlocks.caption: Engagement for each bubble.
mediaBlocks.body: The most common utilitarian task becomes delightful without compromising clarity, helping users quickly find and understand their data usage.

mediaBlocks.caption: Guided flow to drive completion.
mediaBlocks.body: Inline prompts and contextual cues clarify what to do next, improving comprehension for users who previously stalled mid-task.

mediaBlocks.caption: Engagement layer.
mediaBlocks.body: Monetization teams consistently surfaced our gap in offering relevant perks to customers. Further gamifying an interaction in app gave users a reason to return beyond monthly payment.

sections.label: TESTING
sections.title: Research surfaced what drove drop‑off, Boost Bubble closed them with measurable impact.
sections.body: The bubble concept heavily leaned on clarifying completion and system status through repeated patterns. Usability testing proved our hypothesis: the interactive, animated concept significantly improved completion rate and CES scores for key tasks. I leveraged these validated metrics and the coded prototype to pitch the new features directly to Account Executives.

sections.label: OUTCOME
sections.title: From product strategy to prototype.
sections.body:
**Measurable Usability Gains**: Established baseline usability scores for key app journeys, ultimately driving an 18% increase in completion rate and a .8 point improvement in CES after testing the new design interventions.

**Advanced Technical Prototyping**: Transitioned from static Figma explorations to a fully functional coded prototype using Figma MCP and Claude Code. This enabled accurate, unmoderated UserZoom testing of complex micro-interactions, animations, and a native rewards system that static screens could not support.

**Cross-Functional Business Alignment**: Synthesized the validated usability data and interactive prototype into a strategic presentation for 4 Account Executives, successfully demonstrating how targeted UX investments drive user engagement and support future business goals.
